candidate.rationale: The ExecSpecEq trait already specifies ensures: res == (this.deep_view() =~~= other.deep_view()). Adding the same postcondition on the impl is redundant and is flagged as 'already_specified_via_trait' by the checker; the harness errors (missing imports, private module) show adding the impl-level ensures won't fix the underlying verifier/import issues. Rely on the trait-level spec instead. If an impl-specific property is required, fix the import/privacy problems and then add a non-redundant, stronger ensures.
risks: Re-adding the same postcondition duplicates trait-level specs and provokes verifier errors (already_specified_via_trait).

Leaving the impl without an explicit ensures means any mismatch between the external_body and the trait spec could go unnoticed; ensure external_body implementations are kept correct or verified elsewhere.
The harness errors (missing imports, private module) must be resolved separately — attempting to add the redundant ensures does not address these build/visibility problems.
